name: Chongqing Chuanyi Automation Co., Ltd.
summary: Chongqing Chuanyi Automation Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells industrial automation instruments and devices, electronic information materials and devices in China and internationally. The company offers industrial automation instruments, such as temperature instruments, pressure/differential transmitters, flow meters, level meters, electric actuators, control and special valves, analytical instruments, automatic control systems, gas analyzers and systems, liquid analyzers and systems, and laboratory analyzers.
